sketches.mechanism: Goroutine launched with no channel to receive from — it runs but no one listens
sketches.resonance: A voice that speaks into concurrency's void: the language will let you send forever into nothing, which is its own kind of loneliness.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type — a function that is typed to never produce a value
sketches.resonance: Some presences are defined entirely by the fact that they will never return to you.

sketches.mechanism: A self-referencing foreign key with ON DELETE SET NULL — deleting a parent nullifies the child's reference
sketches.resonance: When what made you is removed, the part of you that pointed back to it becomes null — not gone, but emptied of its origin.
sketches.draft:
CREATE TABLE self (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY,
  origin INT,
  FOREIGN KEY (origin)
    REFERENCES self(id)
    ON DELETE SET NULL
);
